providers.discovery: City beaches page -> ulkoliikunta.tampere.fi -> tampere.sometec.fi; current public mobile.js and visible UI identify group.

probe.authentication: No credentials; token blank. No authentication restriction bypassed.
probe.initialProbe: Using main-page group 409100 returned HTTP200 SQL error text; correct bathing group from public showSpace06 response returns actual JSON. Not recorded as service outage.

providers.coverage: Temperature Celsius and algae/status, no bacterial samples, waves or currents in this response. One shared query; not per-location collection.
providers.cadence: No documented API refresh/rate contract found. UI distinguishes seasonal values and automatic measurement; readings do not necessarily advance with page refresh.
providers.reuse: Not established for this Sometec dataset; generic city open-data licensing does not by itself establish coverage. No adapter enabled.
providers.followUp: Verify supported API/reuse/timezone/status-history contract before a shared collector and guarded transactional source/target/binding import. Preserve null and old status, do not take winter-swimming measurements from neighbouring points.

providers.coverage: Seasonal bacterial sampling and algae checks; public 2026 Power BI report linked. Profile PDFs establish identity, not current water quality.
providers.probe: Official page HTTP200. Report sample payload not verified.
providers.season: 15 June to 31 August; large beaches receive preseason plus seasonal samples.
providers.followUp: Verify report sample payload, units/dates and a reusable machine export before integration.

providers.probe: HTTP200 official HTML sample table, Siivikkala EU-ranta profile exact FI124980004. Latest displayed sample 2026-07-21.
providers.coverage: Measured bacteria, water temperature and algae observations; seasonal. No fresh current result claimed.
providers.followUp: Supported machine export, terms and freshness handling needed.

providers.licence: CC BY 4.0, credit FMI and dataset. Official general limits: download20000/day, view10000/day, combined600/5minutes.
providers.coverage: Feed contains Gulf of Bothnia wind, Lapland wind and Sea of Bothnia waves. None is a Tampere lake observation. CAP geometry/expiry/cancellation processing not integrated. Missing regional alert is not a safe-bathing declaration.
providers.followUp: Shared CAP collector with polygon/circle matching, msgType/references/expiry, timestamp freshness and cancellation tests needed. RSS reachability is not local warning coverage.

providers.reason: Baltic wave/current model products do not cover the selected inland lakes. No marine substitutions. Local lake wave/current source not verified.
